label: sportswars1
title_zh: 让直女也想和你做的十大技巧

lines.en: Let’s talk about “responsibility!”
lines.zh: : 我们来聊聊「责任」!

lines.en: : Aaaaaaaaah!!!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊啊!!!

lines.en: Rika Rokuhara was a normal middle-aged woman. And sure, she’d been arrested on several occasions for protesting and things of that nature. Sure, she wasn’t the brightest tool in the shed.
lines.zh: Rika Rokuhara 是一个普通的中年女人。当然,她因为抗议之类的事被捕过好几次。当然,她不是棚里最亮的那把工具。

lines.en: Sure, she’d give the occasional backroom handjob in exchange for concert tickets or VIP passes or, on one occasion, a large pizza. But none of that meant she didn’t understand responsibility!
lines.zh: 当然,她偶尔会在后台用手为换取演唱会门票、VIP 通行证,或者某一次,一个大披萨。但那些都不代表她不懂责任!

lines.en: : Why do I have to be responsible today?!
lines.zh: : 为什么责任轮到今天?!

lines.en: But that didn’t mean she couldn’t question when and why it would become relevant to her in day-to-day life.
lines.zh: 但这不代表她不能质疑:责任会在日常生活中的何时、为何与她产生关联。

lines.en: : I’m not even a teacher. Why am I suddenly being given teacher-like responsibilities? Does this mean I can ask for a raise? Is this what it means to have a normal job? Why do I have so many questions?
lines.zh: : 我连老师都不是。为什么突然让我承担老师式的责任?这是不是意味着我可以要求加薪?这就是拥有正常工作的感觉吗?我为什么有这么多问题?

lines.en: : Why am I holding this clipboard? Why do I have to cover up my tattoos? Who killed Laura Palmer? Why won’t Rie answer any of my calls? These are all important things, Rika.
lines.zh: : 我为什么拿着这块记事板?为什么我必须遮住纹身?是谁杀了劳拉·帕尔默?Rie 为什么一个电话都不回?这些都是重要的事,Rika。

lines.en: : But no, Rika! You have to read, Rika! You must teach!
lines.zh: : 可是不,Rika!你必须读稿,Rika!你必须教学!

lines.en: She didn’t have to teach. In fact, all she had to do was head over to the soccer field and read off a list of contests that the girls of Class A would be competing in for this year’s Dorm Wars.
lines.zh: : 她其实不必教课。事实上,她要做的只是走到足球场,念出 A 班女孩们将在今年宿舍大战中参加的比赛清单。

lines.en: But she was such a mess that even this proved somewhat difficult. After all, where even was the soccer field? And why was it only called “soccer” in some countries?
lines.zh: : 但她实在太乱,连这件事都被证明有点难。毕竟,足球场到底在哪?以及为什么只有某些国家管它叫「足球」?

lines.en: She manages to steel herself, knowing full well that, despite how confused she was at the moment, she’d overcome this obstacle like she’d overcome so many things before.
lines.zh: : 她努力让自己镇定,心里很清楚:尽管此刻一片混乱,她会像跨越此前无数障碍一样,跨越这一个。

lines.en: Because yes, she was a normal middle-aged woman. She knew what it was like to raise a little girl and she knew the purpose of responsibility as a whole in the grand scheme of things.
lines.zh: : 因为没错,她是一个普通的中年女人。她知道抚养一个小女孩是什么滋味,也明白责任在宏观蓝图中的整体意义。

lines.en: But apart from this baseline understanding of one quality and “Ten Tips and Tricks to Make Even Straight Girls Want to Fuck You,” she wasn’t good at thinking of multiple things at once. And that made this hard.
lines.zh: : 但除了对这一种品质的基础理解,和《让直女也想和你做的十大技巧》之外,她不擅长同时思考多件事。这让眼前的事变难了。

lines.en: Harder than it had to be. Because while she was tasked with opening up this year’s “ceremony,” she was also tasked with never doing anything to embarrass that same little girl she raised.
lines.zh: : 比它本来需要的更难。因为她在负责开启今年的「仪式」的同时,还肩负着另一项任务:绝不让她亲手养大的小女孩难堪。

lines.en: This was one more thing that added to her normalcy. Plenty of children out there want their parents to be as uninvolved as possible. And while that disappointed Rika, she understood it.
lines.zh: : 这又是一件让她显得「正常」的事。世上有大把孩子,希望父母离自己的生活越远越好。虽然这让 Rika 失落,但她理解。

lines.en: She just hoped that little girl would be able to forgive her for crossing paths with her before the final bell rang. And she would. For that little girl loved her mother too, after all.
lines.zh: : 她只希望,在最后一节课铃响起之前与她狭路相逢的这件事,那个小女孩能原谅她。而她会的。毕竟,那个小女孩也爱着她的妈妈。

lines.en: But right — responsibility. Or, like they used to call it where I’m from, “weighing what you want to do against what you’re expected to do.”
lines.zh: : 不过说回——责任。或者,用我家乡的说法:「把你「想做的事」和「你被期待做的事」放上天平称一称」。

lines.en: When the weight of the world becomes too heavy, you’re often forced to shed some. So Rika’s choices at this point in time were “Do my job” or “Don’t interfere with Rin’s life.”
lines.zh: : 当世界的重量变得太沉,你往往被迫卸掉一些。于是 Rika 此刻的选择是「干我的活」或「别干涉 Rin 的人生」。

lines.en: : What the hell is “death ball?”
lines.zh: : 「死亡球」到底是什么鬼?

lines.en: But of course, she quickly forgot all of that the moment something else piqued her interest, eliminating both options entirely.
lines.zh: : 但当然,一旦有别的东西勾起她的兴趣,她很快就把这一切忘得一干二净,把两个选项全部清除。

lines.en: But that’s okay. Because responsibility only matters when there are people who expect something from you. But sometimes, different people expect different things.
lines.zh: : 不过没关系。因为责任只有在「有人对你有所期待」时才成立。而有时候,不同的人期待不同的东西。

lines.en: Sometimes, you have to do something that’s going to upset someone.
lines.zh: : 有时候,你必须做一件会让某个人难过的事。

lines.en: Sometimes, there’s no right choice to make.
lines.zh: : 有时候,根本没有正确的选择。

lines.en: Sometimes, you have to take something that doesn’t belong to you.
lines.zh: : 有时候,你必须拿走不属于你的东西。

lines.en: But you stall and you cry and you stall some more until you throw yourself (or get thrown) on top of your niece’s friend on a roof somewhere and have to fuck her until she pops.
lines.zh: : 有时候,你拖沓、你哭泣、你继续拖沓,直到你扑上(或被扑上)你侄女的朋友、在某处屋顶,不得不干她到她崩解为止。

lines.en: Sometimes, she goes away and it makes you sad. So you do sad things like wander around the city in hopes that there will be something that doesn’t remind you of her.
lines.zh: : 有时候,她走了,这让你悲伤。于是你做些悲伤的事,比如在城市里游荡,盼着能遇到一样不让你想起她的东西。

lines.en: But everything does.
lines.zh: : 但一切都让你想起她。

lines.en: And nowhere is safe.
lines.zh: : 世上没有安全的地方。

lines.en: So while a normal middle-aged woman takes that one quality she can hold in her heart even deeper than the fingers of a bassist under some bleachers somewhere, you’re absent.
lines.zh: : 所以,当一个普通的中年女人把那唯一能捧在心间的品质,揣得比看台下某处贝斯手的手指还要深时——你是缺席的。

lines.en: You have never cared about responsibility.
lines.zh: : 你从来不在乎责任。

lines.en: You are a failure.
lines.zh: : 你是个失败者。

lines.en: And just because I can’t see you right now doesn’t make it any less true.
lines.zh: : 而就因为我此刻看不见你,这一点也不会变得不真。

lines.en: : No, really! The new stuff is great!
lines.zh: : 不,真的!新专辑太棒了!

lines.en: : Huh?
: It’s got the same vibe as the older stuff,  but the polish really shines and the production value as a whole is just way better. It’s super impressive, really.
lines.zh: : 它和老专辑的味道一样,但打磨得更亮,整体制作水准高出一截。真的,令人印象深刻。

lines.en: : But anyway, here are the lockers! And right out there is the courtyard where I eat lunch sometimes. Oh,  and this over here is the gym!
lines.zh: : 总之,这里是储物柜!外面那片是我有时候吃午饭的院子。哦,这边这边是健身房!

lines.en: : What the hell?
lines.zh: : 什么鬼?

lines.en: : Why is Noriko hanging out with a bunch of nerdy white guys?
lines.zh: : Noriko 为什么和一群书呆子白人男生混在一起?

lines.en: : Noriko, don’t go in the gym! I’ve made this same mistake before! You’re better than this!
lines.zh: : Noriko,别进健身房!我犯过同样的错误!你比这强!

lines.en: : Oh, and that crazy, hot lady is Rika. She’s my friend’s mom. She’ll go away if you don’t make eye contact with her.
lines.zh: : 哦,那个又疯又辣的女士是 Rika。我朋友的妈妈。你不和她对视,她自己会走开的。

lines.en: After a brief off-screen explanation detailing why Noriko is giving a small group of white people a tour of the school, Rika makes her way to the soccer field.
lines.zh: : 在一段简短的画面外解说、详细解释了 Noriko 为什么在带一小群白人参观学校之后,Rika 动身走向足球场。

lines.en: Her clipboard also expands in size by roughly 50%%, but that’s an unimportant detail that you probably didn’t even realize until I pointed it out just now.
lines.zh: : 她的记事板体积也膨胀了大约 50%%,但这是个无关紧要的细节——不指出来你多半根本没发现。

lines.en: : So, uhh...hi!
lines.zh: : 那么,呃……嗨!

lines.en: : I know most of you have never talked to me before and probably don’t know who I am but, if you want to know who I’m definitely not, it’s Rin’s mom.
lines.zh: : 我知道你们大多数人从没和我说过话,可能也不知道我是谁。但如果你们想知道我「肯定不是」谁——我不是 Rin 的妈妈。

lines.en: : Oh my fucking God.
lines.zh: : 我的天。

lines.en: : Looking good, Rika!
lines.zh: : 气色不错啊,Rika!

lines.en: : Thanks, girl I definitely don’t know!
lines.zh: : 谢了,我绝对不认识的女孩!

lines.en: : Is it just me or does Rin’s mom have a really nice ass?
lines.zh: : 是我错觉吗,还是 Rin 她妈屁股真的很翘?

lines.en: : Hm? Didn’t she just specifically say she ain’t Rin’s mom?
lines.zh: : 嗯?她不是刚特意说了她不是 Rin 的妈吗?

lines.en: : Oh, Miku. Never change.
lines.zh: : 哦,Miku。永远别变。

lines.en: : Why are you here?! Where’s Imani?!
lines.zh: : 你来这干什么?!Imani 呢?!

lines.en: : Hello, other girl I don’t know! You are very pretty and probably very smart! Imani’s setting up the obstacle course right now, so she asked me to read off this year’s Dorm Wars thingy to everybody.
lines.zh: : 你好,另一个我不认识的女孩!你很漂亮,多半也很聪明!Imani 正在布置障碍赛,所以她让我来给大家念今年的宿舍大战事项。

lines.en: : Just drop it on the ground and one of us will read it. Thanks!
lines.zh: : 直接扔地上就行,我们谁念都一样。谢啦!

lines.en: : But this part specifically states “Despite what Rin says, under no circumstances should you drop this on the ground and let anyone else read it.”
lines.zh: : 但这一段明确写着:「不管 Rin 说什么,绝不可以把这个扔在地上、让其他人来念。」

lines.en: : Why?!
lines.zh: : 为什么?!

lines.en: : I don’t know. Maybe there are some super secret details in it you’re not allowed to know?
lines.zh: : 我不知道。也许里面有些超级机密的细节,不允许你知道?

lines.en: : You...haven’t read it yet?
lines.zh: : 你……还没读过它?

lines.en: : Hah...Nice to meet you too, Rika...
lines.zh: : 哈……也很高兴认识你,Rika……

lines.en: : Miss Rokuhara, if you need any assistance regarding the reading of this year’s briefing, I’d be happy to lend a hand.
lines.zh: : Rokuhara 小姐,如果您在宣读今年的简报时需要任何协助,我很乐意效劳。

lines.en: : Rokuhara? Ain’t that Rin’s last name too? No wonder she had to warn everybody they ain’t related. That’d confuse me too if I didn’t already know the truth.
lines.zh: : Rokuhara?那不就是 Rin 的姓吗?难怪她得特意警告所有人她们没有血缘。要不是我早就知道真相,我也会被搞糊涂。

lines.en: : Nah, I’m good. Imani expects nothing but greatness from me, especially after learning how good I am at kissing. I will not let her down and have promised to read her words verbatim.
lines.zh: : 不用了,我可以。Imani 对我的期待只有「出色」,尤其在领教了我接吻的技术之后。我不会让她失望,我保证一字不差地念她的稿。

lines.en: : Oh my God, stop!
lines.zh: : 我的天,住口!

lines.en: : I will now read words to you!
lines.zh: : 现在我要为你们念字了!

lines.en: : Ladies and other ladies, thank you for coming to this year’s annual Dorm Wars event! Even if it’s taking place during a school day that you were all obligated to attend.
lines.zh: : 女士们与其他女士们,感谢各位参加今年一年一度的宿舍大战!即便它被安排在你们全员必须到校的上课日举行。

lines.en: : Given the lack of testosterone this year and the absence of the man you’d normally call the prize, I’ve decided to make things function a little differently.
lines.zh: : 鉴于今年睾酮的短缺、以及你们平时称为「奖杯」的那位男士的缺席,我决定让赛制稍微变化一下。

lines.en: : From what I understand, the Dorm Wars have been synonymous with individual competition over the last few years. With some minor exceptions like Makoto’s weird Sensei-guarding game.
lines.zh: : 据我了解,过去几年「个人竞赛」几乎就是宿舍大战的同义词。除了 Makoto 那个诡异的「守护 Sensei」小游戏之类的例外。

lines.en: : It wasn’t that-
lines.zh: : 没有那么——

lines.en: : It is at this point that Makoto will interject about how it wasn’t that weird and you should say, “Shut up, Makoto.”
lines.zh: : 此时 Makoto 会插嘴说没那么怪,而你们要说:「闭嘴,Makoto。」

lines.en: : Shut up, Makoto! I’m saying this because I have to, not because I want to!
lines.zh: : 闭嘴,Makoto!我说这话是因为不得不,不是因为我想!

lines.en: : Now, direct your attention back to the clipboard and continue reading.
lines.zh: : 现在,把注意力转回记事板,继续念。

lines.en: : While individual competition is fine and good, it’s counterintuitive to the entire point of sports day. Which is why, this year, a greater emphasis will be placed on teamwork.
lines.zh: : 虽然个人竞赛无可厚非,但它与运动会的精神背道而驰。所以今年,我们将更强调团队合作。

lines.en: : As such, I will not be assigning specific people to specific competitions and, instead, allow you girls to choose who will be competing in each event yourselves!
lines.zh: : 因此,我不会指派具体的人参加具体的项目,而是让你们女孩们自己选择每一项的参赛者!

lines.en: : Ourselves? But that means-
lines.zh: : 我们自己选?但那意味着——

lines.en: : Someone else will interject here and you will tell them there are caveats before an uprising takes place!
lines.zh: : 这里会有别人插嘴,你们要在暴动发生前告诉他们「有附加条款」!

lines.en: : Despite giving you the freedom to choose combatants yourselves, bear in mind that all students must participate in at least one competition! With the exception of Ami as her absence is already noted.
lines.zh: : 尽管把选择参赛者的自由交给你们,但请记住:所有学生至少必须参加一项比赛!Ami 除外,她的缺席已被登记在案。

lines.en: : Failure to adhere to this rule will result in a penalty of minus one point for each girl who does not participate.
lines.zh: : 违反此规则者,每一名不参赛的女孩将被扣除一分。

lines.en: : Oh, cool. This means I can abstain so long as we win a bunch of contests early. Good luck, Uta.
lines.zh: : 哦,太好了。这意味着只要我们早期多赢几项,我就可以弃权。加油,Uta。

lines.en: : Yumi’s not even here yet. So at this rate, you two might just cancel each other out.
lines.zh: : Yumi 还没到场呢。照这个速度,你们俩可能刚好互相抵消。

lines.en: : Let’s see, where was...right. As always, there will be a total of ten competitions for a total of ten points. But the majority of these competitions will be team-focused and require multiple participants.
lines.zh: : 我看看,念到哪了……对。一如既往,总共十个项目、共十分。但其中大多数以团队为核心,需要多名参赛者。

lines.en: : But seeing as not all of you are athletic, I’ve decided to throw a couple competitions into the mix that focus on other strengths so everyone will have an opportunity to compete.
lines.zh: : 不过,考虑到不是每个人都擅长运动,我决定加入几个比拼其他特长的项目,让每个人都有机会上场。

lines.en: : Additionally, the final two competitions of the SMUS-DDW: NBA - TEAaOKoSSEfBaB will not require you to choose your competitors.
lines.zh: : 此外,SMUS-DDW 的最后两项:NBA - TEAaOKoSSEfBaB,不需要你们自行挑选参赛者。

lines.en: : One of these will involve names being chosen from a hat and the other will be a special showdown between yours truly and the evil Wakana Watabe of Class B, who will be representing the first floor.
lines.zh: : 其中一项将从帽子里抽签定人;另一项,则是由本人与 B 班邪恶的 Wakana Watabe 之间的特别对决——她将代表一楼。

lines.en: : Hell yeah! This means Imani is on our team! She likes us the most!
lines.zh: : 太棒了!这说明 Imani 是我们这队的!她最喜欢我们!

lines.en: : It’s likely more due to the fact that Miss Watabe has been around for longer. Just as the first floor has-
lines.zh: : 那多半只是因为 Watabe 小姐资历更老。一楼也一样——

lines.en: : Blah, blah, blah. Imani is hot. Floor two wins.
lines.zh: : 啦啦啦。Imani 很辣。二楼赢定。

lines.en: : While Imani is, indeed, attractive, there is no one in this school more alluring than Miss Watabe. I would like to join the opposing team if possible, Miss Rokuhara.
lines.zh: : Imani 确实有魅力,但这所学校没有人比 Watabe 小姐更迷人。如果可以的话,Rokuhara 小姐,我想加入对方队伍。

lines.en: : I’m willing to provide a physical bribe if need be.
lines.zh: : 如有需要,我可以提供肉体贿赂。

lines.en: : Hard pass.
lines.zh: : 坚决拒绝。

lines.en: : Are we going to learn what the competitions are ahead of time? Or is this a thing we’re just going to have to figure out once they come up?
lines.zh: : 我们会提前知道比赛项目吗?还是只能等它们来临时再临场发挥?

lines.en: : I think I can tell you them now. I just needed to get her “preamble” thingy out of the way since she says you guys are all really resistant to change.
lines.zh: : 我觉得现在就能告诉你们。我只需要先把她的「开场白」之类的东西念完——她说你们对变革的抵触情绪很重。

lines.en: : Wait! There’s a vital piece of information that’s yet to be revealed! The light at the end of the tunnel! The loot inside of the chest that is sports day!
lines.zh: : 等等!还有一条至关重要的信息没有揭晓!隧道尽头的光!运动会宝箱里的宝藏!

lines.en: : Translation: what’s the prize this year?
lines.zh: : 翻译:今年的奖品是什么?

lines.en: : She wrote “TBD.”
lines.zh: : 她写的是「TBD(待定)」。

lines.en: : One of these days, we’re gonna get an actual prize again.
lines.zh: : 总有一天,我们会再拿到一个真正的奖品。

lines.en: : She says, not yet knowing she is going to be crushed under the weight that is the second floor.
lines.zh: : 她说这话时,还不知道自己将被「二楼」这座大山的重量碾碎。

lines.en: : Your floor only weighs that much because of Touka’s boobs!
lines.zh: : 你们楼那么沉,还不是因为 Touka 的胸!

lines.en: : That was entirely uncalled for, Miku!
lines.zh: : 这话就过分了啊,Miku!

lines.en: : Besides, you have Futaba.
lines.zh: : 再说了,你们有 Futaba。

lines.en: : And Ami and Sana and Maya and me! We’ve got a severe disadvantage here and I ain’t about to lose to boob weight!
lines.zh: : 还有 Ami、Sana、Maya 和我!我们这里处于严重劣势,我才不要输给胸的重量!

lines.en: : Can I read the competitions now or do we want to talk more about boobs?
lines.zh: : 我现在能念比赛项目了吗,还是你们还想多聊聊胸?

lines.en: : There’s only one way to truly discover which floor is the most boobalicious and it’s for all of us to-
lines.zh: : 想真正知道哪一层楼最「波涛汹涌」,只有一个办法,那就是我们所有人一起——

lines.en: : Ignore the whore and get back to the task at hand!
lines.zh: : 无视那个浪女,回到正题!

lines.en: : I love it when you talk dirty to me, Chika.
lines.zh: : 我爱你对我讲粗话的样子,Chika。

lines.en: : Man. You’re all horny as hell, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 天。你们一个个饥渴得要命,是吧?

lines.en: : Not all of us...
lines.zh: : 不是所有人……

lines.en: : Just the good ones.
lines.zh: : 只是优秀的那几个。

lines.en: : I couldn’t have said it better myself.
lines.zh: : 这话我自己都说不出来这么好。

lines.en: : No, but you could have made it way wordier and harder to understand.
lines.zh: : 不,你可以——你只会说得更啰嗦、更让人听不懂。

lines.en: : Yes, but so could Yasu and we all seem to love her.
lines.zh: : 没错,但 Yasu 也可以,而我们都挺爱她的。

lines.en: : Love is but a delusional state of mind in relation to all but He who-
lines.zh: : 爱不过是一种妄想的心境,对万物皆然,唯独除祂——

lines.en: : Once Yasu begins to preach, things have gone too far. At that point, please read out the competitions regardless of the current conversational status. Roger.
lines.zh: : 一旦 Yasu 开始布道,事情就过头了。到那时,请无视当前的对话状态,直接念比赛项目。收到。

lines.en: : Competition one — egg toss. Two girls from each floor face off against one another to see who can keep their egg alive the longest.
lines.zh: : 项目一——扔鸡蛋。每层楼两名女孩对阵,看谁能让鸡蛋存活最久。

lines.en: : Competition two — trivia. A one-on-one return of everyone’s favorite knowledge-based competition that’ll serve as an opportunity to get non-athletes involved again.
lines.zh: : 项目二——知识问答。大家最爱的知识竞猜一对一回归,让不擅长运动的女孩重新参与进来。

lines.en: : Competition three — obstacle course. Another one-on-one competition that’s sure to get the hearts of everybody pumping due to its crazy and quirky nature. Bring a weapon.
lines.zh: : 项目三——障碍赛。又一项一对一比赛,其疯狂古怪的性质必将让所有人的心跳加速。请携带武器。

lines.en: : Well, we’ve found Ayane’s competition.
lines.zh: : 好,我们找到了 Ayane 的项目。

lines.en: : And...Tsuneyo’s...
lines.zh: : 还有……Tsuneyo 的……

lines.en: : My entire body is a weapon. I will prove this once more today.
lines.zh: : 我的全身都是武器。今天,我将再次证明这一点。

lines.en: : Competition four — cheerleading. Two girls from each floor will team up to see who can form the best cheer. Please remember you are at school and keep most of your clothes on.
lines.zh: : 项目四——啦啦队。每层楼两名女孩组队,比谁的应援更精彩。请记住你们在学校,大部分衣物请保持在身上。

lines.en: : Tch.
: Competition five — scavenger hunt. A sports day classic and the last one-on-one competition prior to the teacher showdown at the end.
lines.zh: : 项目五——寻宝 hunt。运动会的经典项目,也是压轴教师对决前的最后一场一对一。

lines.en: : Competition six — relay race.
lines.zh: : 项目六——接力赛。

lines.en: : Heck yeah! It’s finally my time to shine! No more of that fashion show nonsense!
lines.zh: : 太棒了!终于轮到我闪耀了!别再搞什么时装秀了!

lines.en: : Awww but gyaru Miku was adorable and I miss her!
lines.zh: : 呜呜,但辣妹 Miku 那么可爱,我想她!

lines.en: : Fast Miku is better! Y’all ain’t got a chance! Ya hear me?!
lines.zh: : 快速 Miku 才是本体!你们一点机会都没有!听到没?!

lines.en: : I see you guys already understand what a relay race is, but I should probably let you know that one is going to be three-on-three.
lines.zh: : 我看你们已经明白接力赛是什么了,不过我应该说明:这一项是三对三。

lines.en: : But, moving onto competition seven — death ball. There are currently no details about what death ball is. Please check back later.
lines.zh: : 但继续项目七——死亡球。目前关于死亡球没有任何细节。请稍后再查。

lines.en: : Well, that’s not worrying at all.
lines.zh: : 嗯,一点都不让人担心呢。

lines.en: : Death is-
lines.zh: : 死亡是——

lines.en: : Competition eight — the five-legged race.
lines.zh: : 项目八——五足赛跑。

lines.en: : Five? Are you sure it’s not supposed to be the three-legged race?
lines.zh: : 五足?你确定不是三人四足?

lines.en: : It says, “Not three!” in parentheses, so probably.
lines.zh: : 上面用括号写着「不是三!」,所以大概是五。

lines.en: : Where...are we supposed to get the extra legs?...
lines.zh: : 那……我们要去哪里弄多余的腿?……

lines.en: : I’ll call my skull guy. He’ll know what to do.
lines.zh: : 我打电话给我的颅骨供应商。他知道该怎么办。

lines.en: : Competition nine — the newly-newlywed game.
lines.zh: : 项目九——新婚夫妇游戏。

lines.en: : Wait, is that the game being randomly assigned to us?
lines.zh: : 等等,就是随机分配给我们的那个游戏吗?

lines.en: : And what time is that starting exactly? I want to know when I should head back to the dorm.
lines.zh: : 还有那个具体几点开始?我想知道我该几点回宿舍。

lines.en: : What even...is a newly-newlywed?
lines.zh: : 「新婚夫妇」到底……是什么?

lines.en: : Beats me, but it’ll sure make somebody happy with the amount’a bisexuals we’ve got up in here.
lines.zh: : 我哪知道,不过以我们这里的双性恋浓度,肯定有人会为此开心。

lines.en: : Present.
: Present.
: Doing anything later, Chika?
lines.zh: : 一会儿有空吗,Chika?

lines.en: : Yes, avoiding you.
lines.zh: : 有,忙着躲你。

lines.en: : And competition ten — a very special teacher showdown featuring a classic party game while the night comes to an end.
lines.zh: : 项目十——一场非常特别的教师对决,以经典派对游戏收尾,伴随夜幕降临。

lines.en: : The following morning, we’ll reconvene and read out the results of the competition. But please be advised that there will be no unapproved “bonus contests” this year. There will be no exceptions.
lines.zh: : 次日早晨,我们将再次集合,宣布比赛结果。但请注意:今年不会有未经批准的「加分赛」。没有例外。

lines.en: : That is all.
lines.zh: : 念完了。

lines.en: : Hah...I love sports day, but this just feels wrong without Sensei. What good is a competition if we don’t have a handsome older man to choose which one of us is the winner?
lines.zh: : 哈……我爱运动会,但没有 Sensei,总觉得不对劲。如果连一个英俊的年长男人来裁定我们谁是赢家都没有,比赛还有什么意义?

lines.en: : Yeah, I’m not doing this.
lines.zh: : 对,我不参加了。

lines.en: : What do you mean you’re not doing this? Didn’t you hear Rika? We’ll lose a point for every girl who doesn’t compete.
lines.zh: : 你说不参加是什么意思?没听见 Rika 的话吗?每有一个女孩不参赛,我们扣一分。

lines.en: : Didn’t you hear the annoying, anti-social green-haired girl? She’s not going to compete either. Which means that even if Yumi and I don’t compete, we’ll only have a one-point disadvantage.
lines.zh: : 没听见那个讨厌的、反社会的绿毛女孩吗?她也不参加。也就是说,就算我和 Yumi 不参加,我们也只落后一分。

lines.en: : But...we’re already down one girl with Ami being absent. And even if she’s excused, expecting seven of us to handle the rest of the competitions is putting way too much weight on our shoulders.
lines.zh: : 可是……Ami 缺席,我们已经少一个人了。就算她被豁免,指望我们七个人包揽剩下的比赛,肩上的担子也太重了。

lines.en: : Are you saying you aren’t up to the challenge?
lines.zh: : 你是在说你应对不了挑战吗?

lines.en: : No, I’m saying I don’t understand why you’re trying to drop out before we’ve even distributed roles.
lines.zh: : 不,我是说我不明白,为什么分配任务还没开始你就想着弃权。

lines.en: : Oh. Because I’m leaving.
lines.zh: : 哦。因为我要走了。

lines.en: : Leaving?
lines.zh: : 走了?

lines.en: : Yeah. This sucks. I don’t want to be here anymore.
lines.zh: : 对。这太烂了。我不想再待在这里。

lines.en: : Maya...you can’t just leave. The whole point of sports day is to work as a team. You’re really going to just...give us a handicap like that?
lines.zh: : Maya……你不能说走就走。运动会的全部意义就是团队协作。你真的要就这样……让我们全体残障参赛?

lines.en: : That’s the plan, yeah. Besides, there’s something else I want to do instead.
lines.zh: : 计划就是这样。再说,我有别的更想做的事。

lines.en: : And what’s that? What’s more important than-
lines.zh: : 什么事?有什么比——

lines.en: : You’re tired of waiting, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 你厌倦等待了,对吧?

lines.en: : Why now?
lines.zh: : 为什么是现在?

lines.en: : Why would you wait until we’re all together to break off and follow your heart?
lines.zh: : 你为什么要等到我们全员到齐,才脱离队伍、去追随你的心?

lines.en: : I’m afraid I don’t know what you’re talking about.
lines.zh: : 恐怕我不知道你在说什么。

lines.en: : Maya, you know what I’m talking about. You can’t fool me.
lines.zh: : Maya,你知道我在说什么。你骗不了我。

lines.en: : Right. Because...Past-Maya already explained to you how she felt or something, correct? And you’ve transplanted those feelings into Real-Maya. IE: me.
lines.zh: : 对。因为……「过去的 Maya」已经向你解释过她的感受或者什么了吧?而你把那些感情,移植到了「真实的 Maya」身上。也就是我。

lines.en: : I just don’t understand why it has to be now. You’ve had so many other chances.
lines.zh: : 我只是不明白,为什么非得是现在。你有过那么多别的机会。

lines.en: : You don’t have to understand. You just have to cover for me and do your best to win all of the competitions while I go “follow my heart” as you so aptly put it.
lines.zh: : 你不需要明白。你只需要替我打掩护、尽你们所能赢下所有比赛,而我呢,就像你精辟总结的那样,去「追随我的心」。

lines.en: : Because that’s what it is and you know it.
lines.zh: : 因为事情就是这样,你心知肚明。

lines.en: : Do I?
lines.zh: : 是吗?

lines.en: : What will you do if you find him?
lines.zh: : 如果你找到他,你会怎么做?

lines.en: : Who?
: What will you do if you find him?
lines.zh: : 如果你找到他,你会怎么做?

lines.en: : Would you believe me if I said I was going to ride him like a mechanical bull?
lines.zh: : 我说我要像骑机械公牛一样骑他,你信吗?

lines.en: : Woah.
: You want honesty? There you go. Were you hoping for a different answer?
lines.zh: : 你要坦诚?给你坦诚。你是不是期待一个不一样的答案?

lines.en: : I’m just...not used to hearing you be so open like that.
lines.zh: : 我只是……不习惯你这么敞开地说话。

lines.en: : And I’m not used to you prying personal details out of me like this.
lines.zh: : 而我也不习惯你这样撬我的私事。

lines.en: : You’ve been acting weird lately, Ayane. And all of this gaslighting about how I’m not who I think I am and that you know so much about me is starting to get on my nerves.
lines.zh: : 你最近很反常,Ayane。你一直在煤气灯我——什么「我不是我以为的那个人」、什么「你对我了如指掌」——已经开始让我烦躁了。

lines.en: : So please excuse me while I go confront a grown man and ultimately allow him to use my body like a sex toy.
lines.zh: : 所以请原谅,我要去找一个成年男人对峙,并最终允许他把我当成充气玩偶使用。

lines.en: : Peace.
lines.zh: : 拜拜。

lines.en: : Oh, and good luck or whatever.
lines.zh: : 哦,还有,祝你好运还是什么的。

lines.en: : Have fun.
lines.zh: : 玩得开心。

lines.en: : Well, I don’t like this one bit.
lines.zh: : 嗯,我一点都不喜欢这样。

lines.en: : Nodoka.
lines.zh: : Nodoka。

lines.en: : Yes, my love?
lines.zh: : 怎么了,我的爱?

lines.en: : You’re staring at me an awful lot today.
lines.zh: : 你今天盯着我看得也太多了。

lines.en: : Am I?
lines.zh: : 有吗?

lines.en: : You sure are. And it’s starting to creep me out.
lines.zh: : 就是很多。而且开始让我发毛。

lines.en: : You just seem...different. That’s all. More...depraved.
lines.zh: : 你只是看上去……不太一样。就这样。更……堕落了。

lines.en: : Ah, thank you.
lines.zh: : 啊,谢谢夸奖。

lines.en: : Did something happen? A chance encounter on a long walk home? A secret rendezvous with a boy you met on the Internet? A girl perhaps?
lines.zh: : 发生什么事了?回家路上的艳遇?和网上认识的男孩的密会?还是一个女孩?

lines.en: : Why would I tell you even if any of that was true? It would just end up in a book.
lines.zh: : 就算都是真的,我为什么要告诉你?那些只会变成你书里的章节。

lines.en: : And that doesn’t excite you?
lines.zh: : 而那不让你兴奋吗?

lines.en: : Thank you very much.
lines.zh: : 非常感谢。

lines.en: : Otoha, from one creator to another, doesn’t the idea of being a part of something greater have some sort of appeal to you? I assumed you’d love simply being a character.
lines.zh: : Otoha,创作者对创作者——成为「更宏大之物」的一部分,这难道不吸引你吗?我以为你会喜欢仅仅作为一个角色存在。

lines.en: : For all you know, a young boy could stumble across my work accidentally and take great pleasure in your exploits.
lines.zh: : 说不定哪个小男孩无意间读到我的作品,并在你的风流韵事中获得极大的快感呢。

lines.en: : Mhm. Right. Or you could.
lines.zh: : 嗯哼。对。或者「你自己」读得津津有味。

lines.en: : And that’s a bad thing?
lines.zh: : 那是坏事吗?

lines.en: : Thank you very much.
lines.zh: : 非常感谢。

lines.en: : Anyway. As I was saying-
lines.zh: : 总之。正如我刚才所说——

lines.en: : Yeah, forget what you were saying. Why do people keep coming over here and handing you a sheet of paper?
lines.zh: : 对,忘掉你刚才说的吧。为什么老有人过来塞给你一张纸?

lines.en: : Whatever do you mean?
lines.zh: : 此话怎讲?

lines.en: : You’re literally holding onto them. They’re right there.
lines.zh: : 你手里真的就攥着好几张。就在那里。

lines.en: : Otoha, you’re going to have to speak up. I can’t quite hear you.
lines.zh: : Otoha,你说话能不能大点声。我听不太清。

lines.en: : Nodoka, what are you planning this time? What is this?
lines.zh: : Nodoka,你这次又在策划什么?这是什么?

lines.en: : I’m not planning anything, Otoha.
lines.zh: : 我没有策划任何事,Otoha。

lines.en: : I’m just trying to give back to the community.
lines.zh: : 我只是想回馈社区。
